test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Because of some inevitable circamstances, the conference was postponed indefinite, indefinitely but the members could not be informed.
solution:
The correct answer is Circamstances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word 'Circamstances' is 'Circumstances'.
 
• The word 'circumstances' means **a fact or ****condition connected with or relevant to an event or action**.
 
 
• *Example: We wanted to marry but **circumstances** didn't permit.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the incorrectly spelt word is Circumstances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see meaning of other words given in the option-

 
 
• Conference- A formal meeting of people with a shared interest, typically one that takes place over several days.
 
• Indefinite- Lasting for an unknown or unstated length of time.
 
• Inevitable- Certain to happen; unavoidable.
